title: MINDORA — whispering calmness into busy minds
excerpt: Celebrating International WIE Day 2025 with practical strategies for academic stress relief and time management.
content:
MINDORA – Whispering Calmness into Busy Minds was organised by the IEEE WIE Student Branch Affinity Group in celebration of International WIE Day 2025.

The event focused on academic stress relief and time management, featuring sessions by Dr. Jayalath Edirisinghe and Ms. Irangika Abeysundara. Students gained practical strategies to manage their time, reduce stress and maintain mental well-being — fostering a healthier, more productive academic journey.
